docs.description: The selected value. A new value from the server replaces it; the live value is the value property.
Choices from the server: ["A", "B"] or [{value, label, description?, disabled?}]. <sb-radio> children win over it.
Visible label, and the accessible name of the group.
Stack the choices or lay them out in a row.
Server-confirmed value: :state(pending) while the local value differs from the server's value attribute (see revert()).
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command), and the field it submits in a form.

slots.description: <sb-radio value="…" [description] [disabled]>Label</sb-radio> items: markup the group reads as its choices, like <option> in a native <select>. Nothing is slotted; the group renders the items itself.

events.name: change
events.description: When the user picks a choice.

events.name: sb-change
events.description: Same moment. detail: { name, value }: ready for a command.
